Chapter 1136 6: The Shattered Universe (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 1136 6: The Shattered Universe (Seeking Subscriptions)

The Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram consists of eighty-one pieces.

These eighty-one mystical patterns were bestowed by the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, exhausting the essence of Chaos Rule in its profound intricacies.

The twenty-seventh Chaos Mystic Pattern is the last of the eighteen mystical patterns within the Second Realm of Chaos. Comprehending this pattern signifies reaching the pinnacle of the Second Realm in understanding the Chaos Rule.

"So that's how it is."

Lin Yuan felt delighted in his heart. Originally, while observing this Chaos Mystic Pattern, there were still many aspects he couldn't comprehend.

But now, all doubts were gone; every thread of entwined Chaos Qi seemed so wonderfully simple in Lin Yuan's eyes.

"Ancestor of Fierce Sun..."

Lin Yuan felt a surge of emotion, stripping away the essence of the Chaos Rule and displaying it in the form of a mystical pattern. Such a method was simply astonishing.

"However, even with such excellent cultivation conditions, throughout the endless years of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, not a single Thirteenth Layer has been born..."

Lin Yuan couldn't help but feel the pressure.

In fact, since this Origin World was born until now, there have been only six known Thirteenth Layer temporal beings, each establishing a great ancient country.

Besides the very first Thirteenth Layer temporal being, the remaining five Thirteenth Layer temporal beings consist of three from the ancient country established by the first and two from another ancient country.

And the Fierce Sun Ancient Country?

It has not produced a Thirteenth Layer except for the ancestor.

"The Heavenly Venerates of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, as long as they experience enough time, can generally accumulate a trillion credits to possess the ancestor once, even two or three times. Moreover, they will basically comprehend all eighty-one Chaos Mystic Patterns."

Lin Yuan mused silently.

A trillion credits seem unattainable in a short time, but guarding a first-class treasure land for ten thousand years yields one hundred credits.

It's merely holding guardianship for ten trillion years; for the Heavenly Venerates, ten trillion years is not considered long.

Moreover, every time there is a full-scale war between ancient countries, whenever the Heavenly Venerates intervene, they earn rewards of credit.

"Forget it."

"It's too early to think about these things now."

Lin Yuan calmed himself. Currently, he's at the Mastery Realm; considering ascending to the Thirteenth Layer will only be contemplated after achieving perfection in the Chaos Realm.

"Let's look at the twenty-eighth Chaos Mystic Pattern."

With a slight mental movement, a new 'pattern' appeared before Lin Yuan.

From the twenty-eighth onwards, the eighty-one Chaos Mystic Patterns elaborate the mysteries of the Third Realm of Chaos.

Fifty-four mystical patterns encompass the Chaos Third Realm, demonstrating the extreme obscurity and difficulty at this level of the Chaos Rule.

[Your comprehension is extraordinary; watching the Chaos Mystic Pattern, you gain insights into the Chaos Rule...]

Merely contemplating for a moment, Lin Yuan felt that the essence of the Chaos Rule contained in this Chaos Mystic Pattern exceeded the sum of the previous twenty-seven.

"Marvelous, truly beautiful."

Lin Yuan carefully observed and reflected, estimating that comprehending this mystical pattern would take about a thousand years.

In other words, barring any accidents, a thousand years later, Lin Yuan's understanding of the Chaos Rule would reach the Third Realm of Chaos.

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

"The pinnacle of the Chaos Second Realm."

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan's face, "I can attempt to evolve the Yin-Yang Taiji Power of Chaos."

Evolving one's unique power path through the Chaos Rule is an endeavor that only Chaos Void Great Saints can achieve.

Lin Yuan's ability to attempt it now was entirely due to his profound foundation in the comprehension of rules.

One must know that even in an Origin World where the scope of rule comprehension far surpasses that of the Chaos Void, it would require a Great Lord to hope to evolve a Chaos-exclusive power path.

But Lin Yuan?

He began trying from the Mastery Realm.

In fact, if not for the intricate difficulty of evolving the Yin-Yang Taiji Power of Chaos, requiring a high level of comprehension of the Chaos Rule, Lin Yuan could have attempted it in the Path Splitting Realm.

Compared to the singular approaches like Chaos Flame, Chaos Shadow, and Chaos Life...

The Chaos Yin-Yang Taiji is a new power born from the fusion of two entirely different paths.

Within his internal universe.

Lin Yuan's form emerged distinctly.

Roaring.

A massive amount of Chaos Qi gathered in front of him, resembling a chaotic ocean; hot and cold breaths churned continuously in the depths of that ocean.

"Hmm..."

"With insights at the pinnacle of the Chaos Second Realm, it is indeed possible to evolve the Yin-Yang Taiji Power of Chaos, but at what speed..."

Lin Yuan sensed a bit and found that it would take at least ten million years to evolve successfully.

Ten million years?

Although ten million years is nothing to Lin Yuan, having stepped into the Twelfth Layer, lifespan limitations are no longer a concern, it's still too long.

From becoming an evolver until now, how much time has even passed?

"Using insights at the pinnacle of the Chaos Second Realm to evolve the Yin-Yang Taiji of Chaos... it's somewhat too forcing, thus requiring ten million years. If the comprehension of the Chaos Rule reaches the Third Realm, the time for evolution would likely be significantly reduced..."

Lin Yuan appeared contemplative.

The Yin-Yang Taiji Power of Chaos, within it, is based on chaos as the foundation, the vessel. The higher the comprehension of Chaos Rule, the naturally shorter it will take to evolve the Yin-Yang Taiji Power.

The pinnacle of the Chaos Second Realm requires ten million years to evolve the Yin-Yang Taiji Power.

Should Lin Yuan's insights reach the Third Realm of Chaos, it might only take ten thousand years.

Progressing further to attain insights at the pinnacle of the Chaos Third Realm? Perhaps just a thousand to several thousand years will suffice.

"Take it slow."

"I'm not in a rush; even if it truly takes ten million years, I can afford to wait."

Lin Yuan nodded slightly, contemplating in his heart.

...

"However, the help from Hei Yu for mental willpower is indeed substantial. It's only been half a year, and my mental willpower index has increased by at least five million points, reaching seventy-five million."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

No wonder the Hei Yu Nest is considered a first-class treasure land. The ancestor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country is a Thirteenth Layer Time Life Form. What treasures haven't those Great Lords and Heavenly Venerates seen?

Even so, they still scramble to compete for the position of guarding the Hei Yu Nest. This shows the effectiveness of Hei Yu.

"It took me just over half a year to increase my mind willpower index by five million points. It must be because I just started using Hei Yu. It won't take just half a year to gain such an increase again."

Previously, Lin Yuan had never used Hei Yu, which is why he could achieve such a significant increase.

The reason Chi Yang Heavenly Venerate willingly gave up the Hei Yu Nest is not only because he didn't want to offend Lin Yuan but also because his mind willpower issues have been mostly resolved, and Hei Yu no longer has a significant effect on him.

"When I've accumulated extra Hei Yu, I can bring it to the Chaos Void and sell it to those Venerable Saints."

Lin Yuan thought silently. At least until now, he had never heard of any treasure in the Chaos Void that could enhance mind willpower so effectively.

Previously, Lin Yuan had traveled through the Myriad Realms Gate and descended into the Boundless Void, where he slew Void Creatures in the Void Secret Realm, which also increased mind willpower strength.

But this kind of enhancement has a limit and can only increase up to forty or fifty million points at most.

Nothing compares to Hei Yu, which has a significant effect on the mind willpower of those at the Heavenly Venerate level.

...

Between Ripple Cloud Void Domain and Anbo Void Domain.

It is a vast Desolate Void.

The term Desolate Void is a general term referring to the area between two Void Domains.

Void Domains are areas rich in Chaos Qi, suitable for creatures to cultivate and survive. Under the nourishment of Chaos Qi, they more easily give rise to strong beings.

The Desolate Void between Void Domains has thin Chaos Qi, and few strong beings reside here permanently.

If one compares the Chaos Void to an ocean, each Void Domain is like an island in the ocean, while the Desolate Void occupies ninety-nine percent of the ocean's space.

Simply put, in the boundless Chaos Void, the Desolate Void occupies most of the area.

At this moment.

The previously lifeless Desolate Void suddenly emanated terrifying waves of breath.

A fiery red aura continuously collided with an aura of endless dark shadow, and the aftermath spread in all directions.

Natural universes nurtured by the Chaos Void began prematurely moving towards a great destruction.

"Nine Phoenix, just what will it take for you to stop."

The source representing the endless dark shadow aura, which is the Shadow Demon Great Saint, spoke again.

When other Chaos Realm beings break through to the Great Saint level, they are usually congratulated by other Great Saints. Yet after becoming a Great Saint, he, the Shadow Demon Great Saint, was soon after pursued by Nine Phoenix Great Saint.

This pursuit has continued until now.

It has made the Shadow Demon Great Saint miserable, wondering if he can continue to focus on cultivating.

"Stop?"

Nine Phoenix Great Saint sneered, "If you can resurrect all my kin, I'll stop. How about that? Can you do it?"

"That's impossible."

The Shadow Demon Great Saint shook his head.

Nine Phoenix Great Saint, being a naturally phenomenal life form, and most of his kin had crossed into the Twelfth Layer, freeing themselves from the constraints of the river of time. How can they be resurrected?

Freeing themselves from the constraints of the river of time indeed breaks the shackles of lifespan, but at the same time, it also loses the opportunity for resurrection.

"Hmph."

Nine Phoenix Great Saint said nothing in response, instead using the Chaos Flame, filled with boundless vitality, to strike toward the Shadow Demon Great Saint.

The Shadow Demon Great Saint's form became indistinct, and the Chaos Flame struck the distant Desolate Void.

However.

Bang!

A faint tearing sound echoed.

Where the Chaos Flame had struck, a fragment of space-time appeared, seemingly revealing a corner of a great world.

Wisps of Xuanhuang Qi spread and coiled around.

"What is that?"

Nine Phoenix Great Saint and Shadow Demon Great Saint immediately noticed this scene. Rarely in sync, they stopped and observed the fragment of space-time that appeared.

"This fragment of space-time should be one of the entrances to a universe, originally hidden in the depths of space-time, but was revealed by my strike?"

Nine Phoenix Great Saint was skeptical.

"It's not a natural universe, but a postnatal universe. Only an Absolute Great Saint, perhaps even a strong one among Absolute Great Saints, could have created such a vast universe."

Shadow Demon Great Saint similarly discerned much.

In the Chaos Void, there are two types of universes.

One is the natural universe, a universe nurtured by the Chaos Void.

The other is a postnatal universe, created by beings at the Absolute Great Saint level.

A postnatal universe cannot have the indestructible qualities of a natural universe, but in terms of foundations, it surpasses the latter by far.

After all, it was created by an Absolute Great Saint.

An Absolute Great Saint can create a postnatal universe and set their own rules within it, often using it as their lair.

"Opportunity, this is a great opportunity."

The Shadow Demon Great Saint was wildly joyous inside—a universe created by an Absolute Great Saint? Especially considering the current situation, this Absolute Great Saint should no longer be present, or else it could never have been struck to reveal a corner.

...

Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, Star Tears 'Fragment World.'

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged, pondering over the twenty-eighth Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram.

Suddenly.

At this moment.

Lin Yuan's expression slightly changed.

With a flick of his right hand, a piece of beast skin appeared.

The beast skin floated and drifted, emitting an indefinite aura. The mysterious map on its surface faintly glimmered with light.
